text: I took this backpack on a weekend hiking trip, and the padded straps stayed comfortable through eight miles of uneven trail. My shoulders never ached. The side pocket, however, was awkward; my water bottle wobbled and was hard to reach. The main zipper caught once on fabric, but freed easily. Overall, a solid, comfortable pack with minor flaws.
task: Write a fictional first-person review of a backpack after a weekend trip: comfortable straps, awkward side pocket, and a zipper that caught once.
